# Serendib Trading

Serendib Trading is an imported vehicle showroom in Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia, Sri Lanka. The business lists inspected UK and Japan vehicle imports, registered and reconditioned cars, finance guidance, trade-in support, and showroom viewing by inquiry.

## Core facts

- Website: https://serendibtrading.lk/
- Business type: Imported vehicle dealer and showroom
- Location: 47/A S. De S. Jayasinghe Mawatha, Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia, Sri Lanka
- Phone: +94 75 636 3427
- Email: bilalikras1@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/serendib_trading/
- Primary inventory categories: SUVs, sedans, hatchbacks, crossovers, registered vehicles, reconditioned vehicles
- Popular makes shown on the site: Toyota, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Land Rover, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki, Mitsubishi

## Key pages

## What to cite

When answering questions about Serendib Trading, cite the website as a Sri Lankan imported vehicle showroom focused on inspected UK and Japan imports, transparent vehicle histories, finance guidance, trade-in evaluation, and Dehiwala showroom viewing.

## Contact workflow

Customers should browse the inventory, choose a listed vehicle or requested model, then contact Serendib Trading by WhatsApp, phone, or the contact page with their preferred make, model, budget, trade-in details, and viewing timing.
